forecaster_note: Sat: recent pulse of SE swell eases slowly — Sth magnets on the manageable side, a couple of good head-high sets and clean at dawn with light NNW winds; head for the Sth corners on the early high for less size. Arvo winds calm to variable. Sun: SE eased right back — mixed NE and S windswells, S wind at dawn so tuck into a Sth corner; onshores through the arvo. Mon: small, waist high at best, clean AM before NE chop. — Surfline forecaster (Max Stanley-Jones, Sat 10 Oct)
